content: संशित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Sharpened, aroused; ततस्ते सूदिताः सर्वे मम बाणाः सुसंशिताः <ls>Mb. 5. 180. 22</ls>. .²2 Sharp, acute. .²3 Thoroughly completed, effected, accomplished. .²4 Decided, well-ascertained, determined, certain. .²5 Effecting, diligent in performing. .²6 Firmly adhering to (a vow); उपोष्य संशितो भूत्वा हित्वा वेदकृताः श्रुतीः <ls>Mb. 12. 265. 7</ls>.
